name: yolo
description: Yolo: a private, agent-driven media service, with one player for the Tesla browser and every other browser
author: HaitianLiu5 (https://github.com/HaitianLiu5)

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w clients/tesla && npm run test:unit -w service/core -w service/plugin-api -w service/control -w service/node -w plugins/source-plex -w plugins/source-ytdlp -w plugins/source-example && node --test scripts/*.test.js ops/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration -w clients/tesla && npm run test:integration -w service/control
scripts.check: npm run doc-sync && npm run build && npm test
scripts.check:core: npm run doc-sync && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.build: npm run build -w clients/tesla && npm run build -w service/control
